# asc_security_rules (Data Source)

Retrieves ingress and egress rules for a Security Group in the ASC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List rules for a specific Security Group
data "asc_security_rules" "example" {
  security_group_name = "db-access"
}

# Output ingress rules
output "ingress_rules" {
  description = "Ingress rules for the Security Group"
  value       = data.asc_security_rules.example.ingress
}

# Output egress rules
output "egress_rules" {
  description = "Egress rules for the Security Group"
  value       = data.asc_security_rules.example.egress
}

# Output count of all rules
output "total_rule_count" {
  description = "Total number of rules"
  value       = length(data.asc_security_rules.example.ingress) + length(data.asc_security_rules.example.egress)
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `security_group_name` (String) The name of the security group to list rules for.

### Read-Only

- `egress` (Attributes List) Egress rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress))
- `ingress` (Attributes List) Ingress rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ingress))

- `ports` (Attributes List) Ports for this rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress--ports))
